facts.text: Saren died mysteriously while out hunting.
Many people suspect Keth is responsible for Saren's death.
Keth did not kill Saren but was framed by his brother Kothe.
Kothe made it look like Keth was the killer.
Kothe covets Keth's wife as the motive.
There is a shaming ritual used to exile Kothe.

keyphrases: Kothe makes it look like Keth killer
